questionEn: What fact on the topic “Chemical elements in living organisms and theirs” is formulated without error?
questionUz: “Tirik organizmlardagi kimyoviy elementlar va ularniki” mavzusida qanday fakt xatosiz tuzilgan?
choicesEn: Organic substances consisting of carbon, hydrogen and oxygen (sugar, etc.)
choicesUz: Uglerod, vodorod va kisloroddan (shakar va boshqalar) tashkil topgan organik moddalar.
